Synopsis:
    A strong August US payrolls report keeps the Fed under pressure ahead of two key near-term catalysts: Friday's CPI print and a rate decision the following week. Simultaneously, the ECB is expected to hike Thursday. Diesel prices hit record highs. A far-right party is on the verge of winning power in a German state for the first time since WWII. A side read flags weakening Chinese crude oil imports.
